name: FISHTIME! - a BAT & MTR ghost story
source:
We follow through the eyes of Jyushi and Hifumi on a fishing day. Jakurai invited his division and Nagoya's division to relax with him, but who could have thought that the day was going to end in a disaster?!

Kuko told a story about ghosts to scare Jyushi, but why did we suddenly lose two members?

Is Kuko's ghost story real? 

[From [url=https://kirimaruwm.itch.io/fishtime-bat-mtr-ghost-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们通过Jyushi和Hifumi的眼睛追踪钓鱼日的情况。寂雷邀请自己的师部和名古屋的师部一起散心，谁能想到这一天却以一场灾难告终？！

空子讲了鬼故事来吓唬树脂，但为什么我们突然失去了两名成员？

库克的鬼故事是真的吗？

[来自[url=https://kirimaruwm.itch.io/fishtime-bat-mtr-ghost-story]itch.io[/url]]
